title: Alpine Post
intro: A five-map, zero-combat mail-route RPG built on Pocket RPG Kit and PocketJS: carry three letters up a rainy mountain before the last cable car stops. It runs here on the PocketJS core compiled to WebAssembly, from the same bundle the desktop host and the tests run.

alpine-post.title: Alpine Post — 山巅邮路
alpine-post.description: The hamlet, the farm, the mine, the pine trail and the lighthouse. Leave it alone for 10 seconds and it plays the whole route itself; press any key to take over.

controls.action: Walk, pick an answer. During the demo, any key takes over.
Save menu (slots are save codes on the web)

alpine-post.pointer: Click a map tile to walk there, click the dialog to advance, press and release a choice to pick it.
